Text.html: S2B Login - SAML SSO : Data Flow Diagram (Level 1)

Authenticates user credentials;
signs Assertion (IdP private key)

D1 SSO Config (GroupId), SP Keys,
IdP Metadata & Certificates

SP signing key,
IdP SSO URL / EntityID
SAML Request (AuthnRequest) to IdP SSO URL
POST SAML Response to ACS URL

Notes: Validation in P6 covers signature (IdP cert from D1), Issuer, Audience, NotBefore/NotOnOrAfter, InResponseTo & required attributes. Invalid response -> login rejected and failure audit event published to D3. Groups without SAML SSO continue the existing login flow after P2. All channels over TLS.
